Game Overview

Brocoli puts players into a clicker experience centered on grow your broccoli empire in Broccoli Land with simple tap mechanics and vibrant charm. Harvest, upgrade, and automate to expand your farm. Conquer challenges, climb leaderboards, and enjoy the satisfaction of farming with whimsical graphics and dynamic events, all wrapped in an irresistibly addictive gameplay loop.

How to Play

Playing Brocoli comes down to a simple loop. Grow your broccoli empire in Broccoli Land with simple tap mechanics and vibrant charm. Harvest, upgrade, and automate to expand your farm. Conquer challenges, climb leaderboards, and enjoy the satisfaction of farming with whimsical graphics and dynamic events, all wrapped in an irresistibly addictive gameplay loop.
